_meta.purpose: A1 open-class vocabulary — the everyday nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs an absolute beginner needs to talk about themselves, their family, food, place, time, weather, basic activities.
_meta.notes: All items at level A1. Nouns carry gender + article; verbs carry pos='verb' and verb_group ('1' for -er, '2' for -ir/-iss, '3' for irregular). examples are short, present-tense, beginner-friendly. Cognate hints (cognate:true) flag items that share an obvious root with English.
